type Cache struct {
    data     sync.Map                    // Thread-safe map
    mu       sync.Mutex                  // For loading coordination
    loading  map[string]*sync.Cond       // Per-key wait conditions
    ttl      time.Duration
    loader   LoadFunc
    hits     atomic.Int64                // Atomic counters
    misses   atomic.Int64
    errors   atomic.Int64
    cleaning atomic.Bool                 // Atomic flag
}

func (c *Cache) Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (interface{}, error) {
    if val, ok := c.data.Load(key); ok {
        entry := val.(*CacheEntry)
        if time.Now().Before(entry.ExpiresAt) {
            c.hits.Add(1)
            return entry.Value, nil
        }
    }
    // ... use sync.Cond for waiting, not busy-wait
}

func (c *Cache) GetMulti(ctx context.Context, keys []string) map[string]interface{} {
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    var mu sync.Mutex
    results := make(map[string]interface{})
    
    for _, key := range keys {
        wg.Add(1)
        go func(k string) {
            defer wg.Done()
            if val, err := c.Get(ctx, k); err == nil {
                mu.Lock()
                results[k] = val
                mu.Unlock()
            }
        }(key)
    }
    wg.Wait()
    return results
}
